    {"name": "comparative_benchmark", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Whether a review benchmarks against other films is a genuine, non-obvious signal.     {"name": "rec_signal", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.82, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Recommend/avoid signal is analytically strong for predicting satisfaction.   ],

  "rationale": "The added columns decompose reviews into distinct, analytically valuable aspect axes (script, acting, production, plot, tone, comparison, recommendation) that give real grouping/modeling leverage for predicting negative satisfaction.
